components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Replay warning: the one stamp-red action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 700 1.08rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid #b3261e; background: #b3261e; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #911d17; border-color: #911d17; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0bf55; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Button
components.description: Mode buttons on the indigo header; filled paper when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { font: 700 1rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid rgba(246,248,239,0.55); background: transparent; color: #f6f8ef; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: rgba(246,248,239,0.12); border-color: #f6f8ef; } .ds-btn-ink[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #f6f8ef; color: #1c2450; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0bf55; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamp Chip
components.description: Risk band as a stamped word.
components.html: MOVE OUT WATCH SAFE
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font: 400 0.85rem/1 'Saira Stencil One', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 5px 8px 4px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 5px; background: #f6f8ef; } .ds-red { color: #b3261e; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-amber { color: #8f5a00; transform: rotate(1deg); } .ds-green { color: #2c6b3c; }

components.name: Replay Stamp
components.description: Rubber-stamped REPLAY tag on anything from the replay warning.
components.css: .ds-replay { display: inline-block; font: 400 1.15rem/1 'Saira Stencil One', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; padding: 6px 12px 5px; border: 3px solid currentColor; outline: 1.5px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; transform: rotate(-3deg); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Paper sheet for the map card and side panel.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #f6f8ef; border-radius: 18px; padding: 18px 22px; color: #1c2450; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(28,36,80,0.35), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(28,36,80,0.18); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 800 1.45rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.northStar: The warning, stamped on the farm map
narrative.overview: HighGround is drawn, not plotted. The farm is a watercolour-and-pencil map, like the one pinned on the woolshed wall, and a weather warning is pressed onto it with ink stamps: MOVE OUT, WATCH, SAFE. The ground is pale paper-green, the frame is woolpack-ink indigo, and one instruction is the loudest thing on screen.
keyCharacteristics: A hand-drawn SVG farm map generated from the API's GeoJSON: no map tiles, works offline, always fits the farm.
Risk shown three ways: watercolour wash colour, a stamped word, and a reason in words.
The warning banner carries the move instruction at display size, in the warning level's colour.
Paper grain on every surface; ink indigo for frame and text.

rules.name: The Traffic Light Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green mean only risk (move stock out / could flood / low risk). No decoration, chart or brand use may borrow them.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Stamp ink sits on paper (a 90% paper patch inside the stamp frame), never directly on a wash, so the word always clears 3:1.

rules.name: The Stencil-Only-Stamps Rule
rules.body: The stencil face is for stamped words. Never headings, never body.

dos: Do draw every map mark from API data (paddock shapes, heights, troughs, shed, river); label anything synthetic.
Do keep the safety line verbatim and visible in the first screen on every viewport.
Do stamp REPLAY on anything from the replay warning.
Do show times only from the server's NZ-time labels.
donts: Don't use red, amber or green for anything but risk.
Don't put stamp ink straight onto a wash.
Don't use the stencil face outside stamps.
Don't add map ornament (trees, gates, stock) that the data doesn't support.
Don't reintroduce map tiles: the demo must work offline.
